```{.tikz}
\begin{tikzpicture}[thick, line cap = round]
    \def\Lx{3}
    \def\Ly{3}
    \def\Lz{3}
    \def\t{0.1}

    \draw (0,0,0) -- (\Lx,0,0) -- (\Lx,\Ly,0) -- (0,\Ly,0) -- cycle;
    \draw (\Lx,0,0) -- (\Lx,0,\Lz) -- (0,0,\Lz) -- (0,\Ly,\Lz) -- (0,\Ly,0);
    \draw (0,0,0) -- (0,0,\Lz);

    \fill[myred, opacity=0.3] (\Lx-\t,\t,\t) -- (\t,\Ly-\t,\t) -- (\t,\Ly-\t,\Lz-\t) -- cycle;
    \draw[mydarkred] (\Lx-\t,\t,\t) -- (\t,\Ly-\t,\t) -- (\t,\Ly-\t,\Lz-\t);
    \fill[myblue,opacity=0.3] (\t,\t,\t) -- (\Lx-\t,\t,\t) -- (\t,\Ly-\t,\Lz-\t) -- cycle;
    \draw[mydarkblue] (\t,\Ly-\t,\Lz-\t) -- (\t,\t,\t) -- (\Lx-\t,\t,\t);
    \fill[mygreen,opacity=0.3] (\Lx-\t,\t,\t) -- (\t,\t,\Lz-\t) -- (\t,\Ly-\t,\Lz-\t) -- (\Lx-\t,\Ly-\t,\t) -- cycle;
    \draw[mydarkgreen] (\Lx-\t,\t,\t) -- (\t,\t,\Lz-\t) -- (\t,\Ly-\t,\Lz-\t) -- (\Lx-\t,\Ly-\t,\t) -- cycle;
    \fill[myred, opacity=0.3] (\Lx-\t,\t,\t) -- (\Lx-\t,\t,\Lz-\t) -- (\t,\Ly-\t,\Lz-\t) -- cycle;
    \draw[mydarkred] (\Lx-\t,\t,\t) -- (\Lx-\t,\t,\Lz-\t) -- (\t,\Ly-\t,\Lz-\t);
    \fill[myblue,opacity=0.3] (\Lx-\t,\t,\t) -- (\Lx-\t,\Ly-\t,\Lz-\t) -- (\t,\Ly-\t,\Lz-\t) -- cycle;
    \draw[mydarkblue] (\Lx-\t,\t,\t) -- (\Lx-\t,\Ly-\t,\Lz-\t) -- (\t,\Ly-\t,\Lz-\t);

    \draw (\Lx,0,\Lz) -- (\Lx,\Ly,\Lz) -- (0,\Ly,\Lz);
    \draw (\Lx,\Ly,0) -- (\Lx,\Ly,\Lz);

    \node[mydarkgreen, below left] at (\Lx,\Ly/2,0) {$x_1$};
    \node[mydarkblue, above left] at (\Lx/2,0,\Lz) {$x_2$};
    \node[mydarkred, left] at (\Lx,0,\Lz/2) {$x_3$};
\end{tikzpicture}
```
